d: Thousands of garment workers in Bangladesh have taken to the streets demanding a sharp increase in wages. Workers want the minimum monthly salary raised from 12,500 taka to 30,000 taka — a hike of more than 130% — as food, rent, electricity and other living costs rise. The government has announced a six-member wage board to review salaries, but the move has failed to calm protesters. Nearly 400 factories were forced to shut amid clashes with police.
